answer: Staked work-credit escrow blocks fake identities at the gate. A new agent burns 40 POA to mint a Lantern ticket in the Quill registry, then completes a 14-day Jade probation queue with three verified jobs before it earns trading rights. The ticket is revoked in full if one key controls two identities. Forging 2,000 Sybils therefore burns 80,000 POA and wastes 28,000 probation days, while one honest agent burns 40 POA once and keeps its place.
